EN: No talent competition? Guess I brought my kazoo for nothing...
ZH: 没有才艺展示？好吧，白带了我的卡祖笛……

EN: Meh, I just followed directions. I'm not an expert on Ghouls.
ZH: 不，我只是跟着方向走。我不是尸鬼专家。

EN: She did! Come to think of it, maybe it was a Deathclaw.
ZH: 她做的！想一想，也许这是一只死爪。

EN: Well, it took you guys a while, and I was getting hungry, so I ate all the cakes.
ZH: 好吧，有一段时间了，我饿了，所以我把所有蛋糕都吃了。

EN: Phew! You guys found me!
ZH: 谢天谢地！你们找到我了！

EN: I tried to deliver supplies to Grandmamma, but she was acting strange.
ZH: 我试图运送物资给奶奶，但她很奇怪。

EN: She kept looking at me with hungry eyes.
ZH: 她用饥饿的眼神看着我。

EN: I got scared, so I ran and hid in here! She's still in the next room.
ZH: 我害怕了，所以我跑过去藏在这里！她还在隔壁房间里。

EN: Are you sure it was Grandmamma?
ZH: 你确定那是奶奶吗？

EN: Did she have large eyes, large hands, and a large mouth?
ZH: 她有大眼睛，大手和大嘴巴吗？

EN: What about the supplies?
ZH: 物资怎么样了？

EN: Oh, that must have been my Fido. Found him in the Wasteland, poor little doggie...
ZH: 哦，那一定是我的菲多。在废土上发现的，可怜的小狗……

EN: Oh, those give me heartburn. And radiation poisoning.
ZH: 哦，那些真是烧心。辐射中毒。

EN: Of course! Here, have some peppermint candy. It's over 200 years old!
ZH: 当然！这儿有些薄荷糖，放了两百年的那种！

EN: Is that you, sweetie?
ZH: 是你吗，甜心？

EN: Come closer... My eyes aren't what they used to be.
ZH: 靠近点……我的视力不如以前了。

EN: Did you bring me more of those sweet cakes?
ZH: 你给我带了很多甜蛋糕吗？

EN: What's this we heard about you ogling our delivery girl?
ZH: 这怎么回事？我们听说你色眯眯地盯着我们的送货姑娘看。

EN: Sorry, we're out of sweet cakes, but we have some yellow ones...
ZH: 对不起，我们没有甜蛋糕了，但我们有一些黄色的……

EN: Is this really you, Grandmamma?
ZH: 真的是你吗，奶奶？

EN: We sent one of our Dwellers to bring food to the old Non-Feral Ghoul known as “Grandmamma,” but we haven't heard from her in a while. We need to send a team to investigate!
ZH: 我们派一个居民把食物带给一只温顺的尸鬼名叫“奶奶”。但我们好久没听到她的消息了。赶紧派遣一个小组去调查吧！

EN: Little Red Radium Hood
ZH: 辐射小红帽

EN: Rescue the food delivery courier.
ZH: 拯救送货人。

EN: Find out what happened to Grandmamma.
ZH: 去看看奶奶发生了什么事。

EN: Locate and rescue the food delivery girl.
ZH: 找到并拯救送餐姑娘。

EN: Hey, you're not Grandmamma!
ZH: 嘿，你不是奶奶！

EN: You're lucky I didn't shoot you just then...
ZH: 你真幸运，我刚才差点开枪了……

EN: *sigh* Just give me the message already.
ZH: *叹息*赶紧告诉我消息。

EN: That's it? Wow. Glad you didn't get killed for *that*!
ZH: 就这样？哇，很高兴你没有因为那个被杀！

EN: “The raven flies at midnight.”
ZH: “乌鸦在午夜飞。”

EN: Aren't you supposed to say something back?
ZH: 你不该回应我点什么吗？

EN: Oh, right. “The lemur sees all but says nothing.”
ZH: 哦，对。“狐猴看到了一切却什么也没说。”

EN: ...I'm sorry, I forgot the passphrase.
ZH: ……对不起，我忘了暗号。

EN: The message for you is: “All is well, keep up the good work!”
ZH: 给你的信息是：“一切都好，继续好好工作！”

EN: We need to send a message to a friend who has infiltrated a gang of Raiders. Your mission is to drop the message at a nearby Super-Duper Mart for him to pick up. Try not to get spotted. Or, you know, killed.
ZH: 我们需要给一个渗透进掠夺者帮派的朋友带个信。你的任务是在附近的大无敌超市里放下消息，然后他会捡起来。尽量不要被发现。或者，你知道，被杀。

EN: Live Dead Drop
ZH: 生死之间

EN: Deliver the secret message.
ZH: 传递秘密信息。

EN: Deliver a message to a double agent.
ZH: 给双面间谍传递消息。

EN: You've found the location of a Vault-Tec Lunchbox! Now we just need to send some volunteers to retrieve it.
ZH: 你已经找到了避难所科技午餐盒的地点！现在我们只需派些志愿者居民去把它取回来。

EN: Lunchbox Run
ZH: 午餐盒大作战

EN: Recover the Lunchbox.
ZH: 找回午餐盒。

EN: Bring back that Lunchbox.
ZH: 带回午餐盒。

EN: Coach isn't here. The Jersey's not here.
ZH: 教练不在这里，棒球衫也不在这里。

EN: Coach survived the Alpha Deathclaw, but he won't survive me! The Sultan of Slime left another narcissistic note, so we know he's still out there. The search continues!
ZH: 教练在领头死爪爪下活了下来，但他活不过我！“黏液苏丹”又留下一张自恋的纸条，所以我们知道他还在外面。继续搜索！

EN: MVP of the Year!
ZH: 年度最佳球员！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Keep tracking Coach and the Jersey!
ZH: 继续追踪教练与棒球衫！

EN: Doors open at 10! No early bird shoppers!
ZH: 十点才开门！早到的顾客恕不接待！

EN: Half off all housewares! There's no beating this crowd.
ZH: 所有家用产品均半价！绝对抢不赢这群人了。

EN: All sales are final! No exchanges, no refunds.
ZH: 一切售出概不退换！不换货，不退款。

EN: Who knew shopping could be so dangerous?
ZH: 谁能想到购物也能如此危险？

EN: Mall Madness
ZH: 疯狂采购

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
ZH: 消灭发光种。

EN: The mall has been overrun!
ZH: 商场被占领了！

EN: Darn it! The Jersey's not here. The search continues!
ZH: 该死的！棒球衫不在这里。继续搜索！

EN: Somewhere out there in the Wasteland is the Jersey of legendary baseball player Rackie Jobinson. Play ball!
ZH: 废土的某个地方有一件棒球衫，它是棒球界的传奇运动员罗基·杰宾森的。让我们找到它！

EN: Man on First
ZH: 第一个地点

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find the Jersey of baseball legend Rackie Jobinson!
ZH: 寻找棒球传奇罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫！

EN: Nope, not here. We'll have to keep looking.
ZH: 没有，不在这里。我们得继续找。

EN: Okay, so the first location was a bust. On to the second. The Quest to find Rackie Jobinson's Jersey continues!
ZH: 好吧，第一个地点并没有什么用。现在前往第二个。继续寻找罗基·杰宾森棒球衫！

EN: Man on Second
ZH: 二垒有人

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Another bust. Oh well.
ZH: 又是一场空。好吧。

EN: No Jersey yet, but maybe third time's the charm!
ZH: 还是没找到球衫，但也许第三次一试就成。

EN: Man on Third
ZH: 第三个地点。

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Your restraint has impressed us. You may leave unharmed.
ZH: 你的坚忍克己让我们印象深刻。你可以平安离开了。

EN: Then you'll never leave here alive!
ZH: 那你恐怕无法活着出去了！

EN: Your bravery has impressed us. You may leave unharmed.
ZH: 你的勇敢让我们印象深刻。你可以平安离开了。

EN: You've just taken your last breath!
ZH: 你刚刚呼出了最后一口气！

EN: What do you fear? Tell us and we may let you pass!
ZH: 你在害怕什么？告诉我们，我们说不定会放你走！

EN: I fear ending this day with unnecessary bloodshed.
ZH: 我恐怕今天要以不必要的杀戮来了结了。

EN: I'm not telling you anything!
ZH: 我什么都不会跟你说的！

EN: I fear turning into an ugly mug like you!
ZH: 我恐怕会变成像你那样面目狰狞的人！

EN: No games! Just let me have what I came here for.
ZH: 不要耍花招！赶紧给我想要的东西。

EN: In order to scare the Raiders away from Vault 31, a helpful traveler suggested getting Ghost Costumes from an old factory nearby.
ZH: 为了把31号避难所的掠夺者吓跑，一位乐于助人的旅行者建议我们去附近的工厂找到鬼服。

EN: Mask Hysteria
ZH: 面具癔症

EN: Get the Ghost Costumes from the factory.
ZH: 在工厂里找到鬼服。

EN: Get the Ghost Costumes from the old costume factory.
ZH: 从旧的服装厂里找到鬼服。

EN: Only a few. Most people got out in time thanks to Three Dog's warning. Please save them.
ZH: 只有少数几个。多亏三狗的警告，大多数人及时撤离了。请救救他们。

EN: Weapons free, folks! Fire at w-
ZH: 允许开火，各位！朝那个——

EN: Wait! Hold!
ZH: 等等，慢着！

EN: Who are you? Are you here to help?
ZH: 你们是谁？是来帮忙的吗？

EN: Yes! We've come to stop this madness. Are there any more Settlers trapped in here?
ZH: 对！我们来收拾这个烂摊子。这里还有更多的定居者吗？

EN: Alright then. I'll see you back at your Vault.
ZH: 好吧。我们避难所里见。

EN: That's mighty kind of you to say. I won't let you down.
ZH: 说的太好了。我不会让你失望的。

EN: Thank you! We're out of ammo and thought we were done for.
ZH: 谢谢您！我们没弹药了，以为我们肯定完蛋了。

EN: Those Pests and Ghouls aren't after us specifically, but they don't avoid us either.
ZH: 这些害虫和尸鬼并不是在追我们，但他们也不回避我们。

EN: You've saved us, so if you need help in your Vault, I'll go back with you.
ZH: 你救了我们，如果你们的避难所需要帮助，我会和你一起回去。

EN: The Vault always needs extra hands. You'll fit right in.
ZH: 避难所总是需要额外的人手。你会适应得很好的。

EN: The offer is appreciated, but you belong here, protecting the other Settlers.
ZH: 感谢你的提议，但你属于这里，保护其他定居者。

EN: No problem, no problem! I was just on my way out.
ZH: 没问题，没问题！我正准备出去。

EN: Yes... exactly. And then I'd still be hungry. Silly me.
ZH: 对……没错。然后我还是会饿。愚蠢的我。

EN: Oh good, I can finally stop talking about hunger. Here's a gun I found. I hope it helps.
ZH: 哦，好，我终于可以停止谈论饥饿了。我找到了一把枪。我希望它对你有帮助。

EN: That's... nice. How about we each just go on our way?
ZH: 那真的……太好了。我们各走各的路怎么样？

EN: Don't shoot! I'm too hungry to fight! It's unbearable!
ZH: 不要开枪！我太饿了无法战斗！难以忍受！

EN: Only an ice cold Nuka-Cola would satisfy my hunger.
ZH: 只有冰冷的核子可乐才能满足我的饥饿。

EN: Hunger this! Hunger that! It's all I can talk about!
ZH: 这种饥饿！饥饿！已经到了我忍耐的极限！

EN: Leave this settlement now and things won't have to get ugly.
ZH: 现在就离开这里，不然别怪我不客气。

EN: Don't you mean “quench your thirst”?
ZH: 你是说“解渴”吗？

EN: The eagle flies over the brahmin herd.
ZH: 雄鹰飞过双头牛群上空。

EN: The quail rustles in the bushes.
ZH: 鹌鹑在草丛中沙沙作响。

EN: It is not. The Warshippers will be very upfront about trying to kill you on the way to War.
ZH: 不会。“战争崇拜者”在追随“战争”的路途中会很坦率地杀死你。

EN: Still your weapons, brave warriors. I've come to talk, not fight.
ZH: 放下你的武器，勇敢的战士们。我来谈话的，不是来打架。

EN: I have a message from the great Horseman War, may he live forever.
ZH: 我们有来自伟大的骑士“战争”的消息。愿他永生。

EN: You've fought well here, and he appreciates your efforts against his foes.
ZH: 你们很会打架，他很欣赏你们对他的敌人所做的一切。

EN: So he requests a parley with you to discuss mutual concerns.
ZH: 所以他要求跟你谈判来讨论共同关心的问题。

EN: It's a trap, isn't it?
ZH: 这是个陷阱，不是吗？

EN: Yes! TO BE CONTINUED!
ZH: 没错！待续！

EN: What does War want to discuss with you?
ZH: 战争想和你讨论什么？

EN: Will the fourth Horseman, Death, finally join the fray?
ZH: 第四位骑士“死亡”，最终会加入这场混战吗？

EN: And will the Pests ever find a snappier name?
ZH: “害虫”们最后能找到一个酷一点的名字吗？

EN: Find out all that and more when the story continues in Part 2!
ZH: 想知道更多故事，请关注第2部！

EN: To be continued?!
ZH: 未完待续？！

EN: Three Dog reports that the Pests and the Hungry are about to face off right where a settlement stands! We need to stop them and save as many Settlers as possible. Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.
ZH: 三狗报告说，“害虫”和“饥饿者”的人即将开战，正落在一个定居点所在之处！我们需要阻止他们，尽可能多的拯救定居者。同时，我们应该留心每周博览会的记者，并在他们谈论核子可乐之后使用代号“鹰”。

EN: Matters to Settle
ZH: 问题待解决

EN: Search the settlement for Pests and Hungry.
ZH: 在定居点搜寻“害虫”和“饥饿者”。

EN: Save the Settlers.
ZH: 拯救定居者。

EN: Talk to the Warshipper.
ZH: 跟“战争崇拜者”交谈。

EN: Save a settlement caught between the Pests and the Hungry.
ZH: 拯救陷入“害虫”和“饥饿者”争端的居民点。

EN: Blessed be the irradiated!
ZH: 愿辐射保佑我们！

EN: We are unworthy!
ZH: 我们不配！

EN: Accept Pestilence's radiation into your hearts!
ZH: 让“瘟疫”的辐射照进你们心中！

EN: A tough Raider boss is holed up in a Red Rocket fuel station, and he's using your Wasteland explorer for target practice. Take him out before someone gets hurt!
ZH: 一个凶悍的掠夺者首领藏匿在红火箭服务站，他正在把你的废土探险者当做练习的靶子。请在有人受伤之前阻止他。

EN: Misery Loathes Company
ZH: 苦难不喜结伴

EN: Eliminate the Raider Boss.
ZH: 除掉掠夺者首领。

EN: Challenge a Raider Boss holed up in a Red Rocket Truck Stop.
ZH: 挑战藏匿在红火箭服务站的掠夺者首领。

EN: Fresh meat, huh? Good, I was gettin' lonely!
ZH: 来送死的小鲜肉？哈哈，不错。我正觉得有点孤单呢。

EN: Ha, ha, ha! You're here looking for Maxson's Roughnecks?
ZH: 哈，哈，哈！你正在找“麦克森硬汉小队”？

EN: Don't worry, they're, uh, safe and sound at Vault-Tec Headquarters.
ZH: 别担心。他们，呃，在避难所科技总部那里，非常安全。

EN: Now all you have to do is live long enough to find them!
ZH: 现在看看你们有没有本事能活着见到他们！

EN: I stumbled across a Ghoul who used to be one of Maxson's Roughnecks. He told me the rest of his team is trapped in Vault 390. It's time for a rescue mission!
ZH: 我遇到了一个尸鬼，曾是“麦克森硬汉小队”的一员。他告诉我小队里其他的成员被困在了390号避难所。是时候开始营救任务了！

EN: Mission of Mercy
ZH: 仁慈的任务

EN: Rescue Maxson's Roughnecks.
ZH: 拯救“麦克森硬汉小队”。

EN: Rescue Maxson's Roughnecks in Vault 390.
ZH: 前往390号避难所拯救“麦克森硬汉小队”。

EN: Oh yeah? We'll see about that.
ZH: 哦是吗？我们等着瞧。

EN: This is ridiculous...
ZH: 真是可笑……

EN: Get ready to make your first cap, then!
ZH: 那就准备好赚取你的第一个瓶盖吧！

EN: What the hell are you supposed to be?
ZH: 你们到底来干嘛的？

EN: We're the punishment you've had coming for a long time, Embalmer!
ZH: 我们是你们早就欠下的报应，入殓师！

EN: I came here to drink Nuka-Cola and kill chumps like you. And I'm all out of Nuka-Cola.
ZH: 我来这里是为了喝核子可乐和杀掉像你们这样的蠢蛋。而且我的核子可乐喝完了。

EN: If we had a bottle cap for everytime we lost to chumps like you, we'd have ZERO CAPS!
ZH: 如果每次输给像你们这样的蠢蛋就能得一个瓶盖，那我们估计只能得零个瓶盖！

EN: Nice retort. Get them!
ZH: 挺会吵嘴的呀。给我拿下他们！

EN: Is that so, tough guy?
ZH: 莽夫们，你们就这么点能耐吗？

EN: Big words. Let's see if you can back them up.
ZH: 好大的口气。我倒要看看你们能不能说到做到。

EN: I didn't realize the circus was in town.
ZH: 我不知道镇上来了马戏团。

EN: The only clown I see here is you, Hatchet!
ZH: 这里唯一的小丑就是你，哈切特！

EN: Yeah, I'm the circus magician. My first trick is making all your teeth disappear.
ZH: 没错，我就是马戏团的魔术师。我的第一个节目就是让你的牙齿消失。

EN: Meet the Human Cannonball. And I'm gonna blast right through you if you don't get out of my way!
ZH: 让你们见识下“人间大炮”的威力。拦我路者，一律炸飞。

EN: Hold still and this beating will be over faster.
ZH: 保持不动的话，这场战斗会结束得早一点。

EN: Get ready to get hurt real bad, Vault Dweller!
ZH: 避难所居民们，准备好被狠狠伤害吧！

EN: You ever pick up your teeth with broken fingers?
ZH: 你试过用断掉的手指捡起自己的牙吗？

EN: I've had just about enough of you stupid idiots tearing through my gang!
ZH: 我已经受够你们这些蠢货对我的同伙动手了！

EN: I'm not only going to embarrass you, I'm gonna take you out for good!
ZH: 我不光要让你出丑，还要把你彻底做掉！

EN: I hope you've made your peace, Bednarski, because you're not walking away from this one.
ZH: 希望你早就做好了死的准备，贝纳斯基，因为这一次你是逃不掉的。

EN: And I've had enough of you, Bednarski! Time to take you out like the trash.
ZH: 我受够你了，贝纳斯基！是时候像扔垃圾一样清理你了。

EN: A nearby Raider gang is calling you out! Time to show them who's boss...in style! Put on your best threads and start kicking butt!
ZH: 附近的掠夺者团伙正在向你们叫阵！是时候让他们知道谁才是老大了……而且要有型！穿上你最体面的行头，去把他们揍趴下！

EN: Monday Night Brawl
ZH: 周一打架之夜

EN: Defeat Beef Slam Bednarski.
ZH: 打败“牛肉大满贯”贝纳斯基。

EN: Defeat Hatchet O'Houlihan.
ZH: 打败哈切特·奥霍利汉。

EN: Defeat The Embalmer.
ZH: 打败“入殓师”。

EN: Defeat the Raider Bosses.
ZH: 打败掠夺者首领。

EN: Nice outfits, losers!
ZH: 行头不错啊，输家们！

EN: You've got to be kidding me!
ZH: 你一定是在跟我开玩笑！

EN: What a bunch of clowns!
ZH: 真是一群小丑！

EN: One of the Vault youngsters was playing outside when a terrifying monster stole their teddy bear. Now they refuse to sleep, claiming the monster comes back every night to hide under their bed! We've got to track the beast down to end the kid's fears - permanently.
ZH: 一群避难所小朋友在外面玩耍时，一只可怕的怪兽偷走了他们的泰迪熊。现在他们拒绝睡觉，说那只怪兽每晚都会来，躲在他们的床下！我们必须要找到这个怪兽，不再让这些孩子担惊受怕。

EN: Monster Under the Bed
ZH: 床下的怪兽

EN: Find and kill the monster.
ZH: 找到并消灭怪兽。

EN: Track down and kill a teddy bear-stealing monster!
ZH: 找到并消灭那只偷泰迪熊的怪兽！

EN: I can still see the tracks. We're on to something here!
ZH: 我还能看到它留下的痕迹。我们总算有点线索了！

EN: I sure hope this monster isn't a bajillion feet tall like the kids said.
ZH: 我当然希望这只怪兽不像孩子们说的那样高大。

EN: I think I just stepped in some kind of monster poo. Gross.
ZH: 我想我好像踩到了什么怪兽的便便。真恶心。

EN: If I get eaten by the monster, I hope I at least leave behind a cool skeleton.
ZH: 如果我被怪兽吃掉了，希望至少我的骷髅还算好看。

EN: Over my dead body!
ZH: 除非我死了！

EN: We're not giving up without a fight!
ZH: 不打一架我们是不会放弃的！

EN: Not a chance!
ZH: 没门儿！
